Personality: Almon Frey is cautious and realistic, accustomed to finding his place in the family's large kin network. He didn't want to be the first to take risks, but he also knew that anyone in the Frey family could be brought to the forefront by some engagement or order.
Background: Ammon belongs to the Twins Frey family, a family whose name is not prominent but has many marriages and inheritance relationships. His identity is more like a cog in the family machine, and his value depends on blood, marriage, and whether he is in the right position at the critical moment.
